question: Which essential amino acid enhances calcium absorption and also plays an important role in the formation of collagen?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lysine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lysine** is an essential amino acid that the body cannot synthesize and must be obtained from the diet.
 
• Lysine plays a crucial role in enhancing calcium absorption in the body, which is vital for bone health.
 
• This amino acid is also essential for the formation of collagen, a protein that provides structure to skin, bones, and connective tissues.
 
• Additionally, lysine is involved in the production of carnitine, a nutrient responsible for converting fatty acids into energy and helping to lower cholesterol levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Essential Amino Acids:**

 
 
• These are amino acids that cannot be synthesized by the body and must be obtained from the diet.
 
• There are nine essential amino acids: histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, and valine.
 
 
 
• **Calcium Absorption:**
 
 
• Calcium is a mineral essential for bone health, muscle function, nerve signaling, and blood clotting.
 
• Vitamin D and certain amino acids, such as lysine, enhance the absorption of calcium in the gut.
 
 
 
• **Collagen Formation:**
 
 
• Collagen is the most abundant protein in the human body, providing structure to skin, bones, and connective tissues.
 
• Lysine is vital for the synthesis of collagen, contributing to tissue repair and skin elasticity.
 
 
 
• **Protein Synthesis:**
 
 
• Proteins are made up of amino acids, which are the building blocks of the body.
 
• Essential amino acids, including lysine, are crucial for the synthesis of proteins needed for growth, repair, and maintenance of tissues.
